def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Reports_by_Military_Consumers.csv"
    # Layout is a formatted table with a title row, then a header row starting on line 2.
    # Keep only the two data columns.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=1, usecols=[0, 1], encoding="utf-8")
    df.columns = ["reportType", "numReports"]
    # Drop blanks and source/footer rows
    df = df.dropna(subset=["reportType"])
    df = df[~df["reportType"].astype(str).str.startswith("Source:")]
    # Parse counts like "99,443"
    df["numReports"] = (
        df["numReports"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).str.strip()
    )
    df = df[df["numReports"].str.match(r"^\d+$", na=False)]
    df["numReports"] = df["numReports"].astype(int)
    return df

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Categories.csv"
    # Formatted table with a blank/title row then header at line 2
    df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="cp1252", header=1, usecols=[0, 1, 2, 3])
    df.columns = ["rank", "category", "numReports", "percentage"]
    df = df.dropna(subset=["category"])
    df = df[~df["rank"].astype(str).str.startswith("Source:")]
    # Clean numeric and percent fields
    df["numReports"] = df["numReports"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).str.strip()
    df = df[df["numReports"].str.match(r"^\d+$", na=False)]
    df["numReports"] = df["numReports"].astype(int)
    df["percentage"] = (
        df["percentage"].astype(str).str.replace("%", "", regex=False).str.strip()
    )
    df["percentage"] = pd.to_numeric(df["percentage"], errors="coerce")
    return df
